items.html: And from these six last [Sefirot] of Yetzira of that time was the body of Adam made, for the body is the secret of the letter Vav, and Yetzira likewise is the secret of the letter Vav. And behold, Yetzira rules in the Land of Israel, as above. Hence it is found that the body of Adam was from the Land of Israel, which is from Yetzira, which is in the middle of the two worlds — Beria and Assiya. And likewise the body of man is the middle of the entirety of man.
